title: Choose Cortex's visual world (round 3)
question: Bolder re-roll, steered to minimal, thoughtful, insightful, mature yet modern. The deal leads with the Variable Specimen.

options.label: Variable Specimen
options.lineage: interactive variable-font specimens: one face, scale contrast, a live weight axis
options.thesis: Confidence you can read: each claim's letterforms settle from hairline to full weight as Cortex verifies it.
options.viewport: Quiet left rail. A large light-weight question, then a single line of mono readouts (plan, searches, verified). The answer below: verified claims at full weight in ink, claims still being checked at hairline weight in grey, unsupported ones struck through faintly. Sources as a compact list under the answer. Ask bar at the foot with a Fast/Deep switch.
options.risk: If the weight animation runs on everything it becomes a gimmick; it must only mark verification state, and freeze under reduced motion.

raised.raise: Suggested follow-ups show only the next decisions ahead, like a junction sign.
One answer owns the column; earlier turns collapse to their question line.
Fast and Deep are an honest visible state on every answer, not a hidden setting.

options.label: Reference Setting
options.lineage: wide-margin scholarly editions with an annotation apparatus
options.thesis: The answer is a small, exact text block; its evidence hangs in a wide margin, ruled to the line it supports.
materials: hairline rules at one device pixel
options.viewport: Narrow answer block centred in a wide margin; hairline leaders connect each citation to its evidence note in the margin.
options.case: Strongest on 'thoughtful, insightful' and on citations, but it reads as a document more than a product, and its print voice is less modern.
options.risk: Drifts into an editorial costume; needs app chrome to stay a product.

options.label: Star Atlas
options.lineage: celestial charts: magnitude dots on a coordinate field
options.thesis: Broad vision: everything Cortex found is plotted as a field of points sized by relevance, with the answer's sources ringed.
options.viewport: Dark navy shell; above the answer, a small evidence field of dots (size = relevance, ring = cited); amber annotations name the cited ones.
options.case: Holds 'futuristic, broad vision' from your first steer, but the field adds chrome that the minimal steer argues against.
options.risk: A decorative starfield if it grows beyond one band.

options.label: Airport yellow
options.thesis: Only the next decision, at monumental scale.
options.case: Loses both axes: loud yellow fights 'minimal, mature'.

options.label: Bitmap specimen
options.case: Loses both axes: retro-digital rather than mature.
options.kept: Rendering mode as an honest, visible state (Fast vs Deep).

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A Perplexity/Linear-style neutral assistant, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Grey sidebar, centred chat column, rounded answer card, sources as a chip row.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every AI wrapper by design.
